map.由样本均值、假设均值与标准差求 t 值: t Value from Sample Mean, Hypothesized Mean and Standard Deviation
map.输入样本均值 x̄、假设均值 μ、标准差 s 与样本量 n，求 t 统计量。: Enter the sample mean x̄, hypothesized mean μ, standard deviation s and sample size n to get the t statistic.
map.📖 查看「由样本均值、假设均值与标准差求 t 值使用指南」: 📖 View the "t Value from Sample Mean, Hypothesized Mean and Standard Deviation User Guide"
map.单样本 t 检验的核心量。: The core quantity of the one-sample t-test.
map.小样本均值检验核心量。: The core quantity for testing means with small samples.
map.df=n−1 查 t 分布。: Look up the t distribution using df=n−1.
map.x̄=120：t=20/3≈6.67，远超临界，显著。: With x̄=120: t=20/3≈6.67, far beyond the critical value and significant.
map.形式相同，但 t 用样本 s 且服从 t 分布（胖尾），z 用已知 σ 服正态。: The form is identical, but t uses the sample s and follows the heavier-tailed t distribution, whereas z uses a known σ and follows the normal.
map.df 决定 t 分布形状，df 小尾巴厚、临界值大，更保守。: df sets the shape of the t distribution: small df gives thicker tails and larger critical values, making the test more conservative.
